macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks rebound, but long-end Treasury yields stay elevated
items.summary: The Dow rose about 1%, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq each gained about 0.4% as investors digested higher Treasury yields and a volatile week in bonds. The 10-year Treasury yield was reported around 4.73%-4.74%, with the 30-year yield above 5.27%.

items.title: Weekly market tone remains cautious despite Friday gains
items.summary: U.S. equities ended the week lower overall even after Friday's rebound, with reports noting weekly losses for the major indexes as bond volatility stayed in focus. Separate market coverage said the S&P 500 and Nasdaq posted weekly declines, while bitcoin surged on the week.

items.title: Treasury buyback expansion helps drive market focus
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's plan to expand bond buybacks and increase the program size beyond $4 billion per issue was a key macro development watched by traders. The move was seen as part of efforts to ease pressure on longer-term borrowing costs.

items.title: Trump denies ordering intervention in bond market
items.summary: President Trump said he did not direct Treasury Secretary Bessent to intervene in the bond market, saying Bessent acted on his own judgment. He also said resolving the U.S. debt burden depends on stronger growth.

items.title: Canada says it will retaliate after new U.S. tariffs
items.summary: Canada announced retaliatory tariffs starting Sept. 8 after the U.S. began enforcing 50% tariffs on a range of Canadian goods. The move raises trade tensions and could affect market sentiment in North American equities and currencies.

items.title: Oil prices continue to firm on geopolitical risk
items.summary: Oil rose as the market reacted to renewed geopolitical risk involving Iran and related sanctions pressure. One market recap also described crude as logging a weekly advance.

items.title: Gold hits multi-month high as investors seek safety
items.summary: Gold climbed to its highest level since mid-May and posted a weekly gain of more than 5%, according to market coverage. The move came alongside weaker risk appetite and concern about bond volatility.

items.title: Anthropic hires Google chip executive to accelerate in-house semiconductor work
items.summary: Anthropic hired a Google chip business executive as it pushes deeper into custom-chip development. The announcement adds to a broader AI infrastructure race among major technology firms.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Crypto market swings sharply as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP face heavy liquidations
items.summary: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP were hit by a fast selloff, with reports saying about $1.71 billion was liquidated across 281,846 traders in 24 hours. Other market reports also described a cascade of forced liquidations as Bitcoin retraced toward the $77,000 area.

items.title: Bitcoin holds near $77,000 after Treasury-driven short squeeze and ETF inflows
items.summary: Several market reports said Bitcoin traded around the high-$77,000 range after a Treasury buyback shift helped fuel a short squeeze. Sources also pointed to renewed strength from spot ETF inflows and improving liquidity conditions.

items.title: Zcash surges to an 8-year high as Grayscale ETF filing gains attention
items.summary: Zcash was one of the biggest winners of the day, with reports showing gains of roughly 34% to 48% in 24 hours. The rally was linked to a Grayscale spot Zcash ETF filing and rising speculation around institutional interest.

items.title: XRP sees major volatility after bridge hack and flash-crash pressure
items.summary: XRP was reported to have fallen below $1 in one account of the market move, while another source described a sharp flash crash tied to broad market liquidations. The moves added to already elevated volatility across large-cap tokens.

items.title: Regulatory push intensifies around U.S. crypto market structure legislation
items.summary: Market coverage highlighted renewed momentum for the Clarity Act and broader U.S. crypto regulation, including reporting that CFTC planning and legislative debate are advancing. One report also noted criticism of prior SEC 'regulation by enforcement' approaches.

items.title: Spot Zcash ETF filing becomes the day’s main project-development catalyst
items.summary: CoinStats reported that Grayscale’s fifth amended SEC filing for a proposed spot Zcash ETF was the strongest confirmed catalyst in the market. The product would trade on NYSE Arca if approved, but approval has not yet occurred.

items.title: Trezor adds HyperEVM support for HYPE and ecosystem assets
items.summary: Trezor announced support for HyperEVM, expanding hardware-wallet coverage for HYPE and related assets. The update is part of a broader wave of infrastructure and wallet-compatibility developments across crypto projects.

items.title: LayerZero begins winding down support for 15 low-activity networks
items.summary: LayerZero said it will gradually end off-chain support for 15 low-activity networks within 30 days and urged users to redeem affected Hydra assets before services stop. The move is a notable ecosystem-maintenance development rather than a price event.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Take-Two escalates legal action over GTA 6 leaks
items.summary: Take-Two Interactive has reportedly begun the legal process to identify the source of recent Grand Theft Auto VI leaks, including subpoenas aimed at Microsoft and Discord. Multiple reports say the company is seeking account data tied to the leak investigation.

items.title: Mortal Shell II launches on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S
items.summary: Cold Symmetry’s Mortal Shell II went live worldwide on Thursday, August 20, with releases on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. The launch makes it one of the notable new game releases entering the weekend window.

items.title: Ubisoft news tracker highlights broader industry developments
items.summary: Current gaming industry coverage continues to focus on major platform and publisher trends, including pricing pressure, hardware sales declines, and the shift in physical game spending. One widely circulated report says U.S. physical game spending hit a record low in July while console sales fell sharply.

items.title: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond gets Latin America release expansion
items.summary: Cygames announced a Latin America version of its next-generation mobile card game Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond. The move is part of a broader set of regional release and service updates from Japanese publishers this week.

items.title: GTA 6 leak story intensifies across gaming media
items.summary: Gaming outlets reported that a second group claimed access to an internal version of GTA 6, adding to the ongoing leak discussion around Rockstar’s next major release. The reports describe the leaks as escalating after a brief period of silence.

items.title: VALO2ASIA reports CRWS retirement from pro play
items.summary: A breaking post from VALO2ASIA says Thai player Crws has announced retirement from professional play. The post is a notable esports personnel update, though additional context on team and timing was not provided in the source snippet.

items.title: Gamescom and upcoming showcase chatter dominates preview coverage
items.summary: Gaming coverage is increasingly focused on Gamescom preview plans and major publisher showcase expectations, with several reports teasing new gameplay and platform announcements. One roundup says Xbox is preparing a large Gamescom program and that Fable gameplay will be shown soon.
